text_block_list.text:
"While training for the Satsuki Sho, it 
ended up getting late into the night. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ryan-chan. Hel-hello~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines...

I bumped into Ines Fujin, who was both my 
roommate and rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines, are you done for the day? Heading 
back to the room ahead of me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I have a meeting with my Trainer after 
this, so I probably can't eat with you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Then I'll just scarf it down real 
quick by myself.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my pre-bed stretches next time 
too♪

They are roommates and both share a 
passion for exercise. This must be how the 
two of them spend their days together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines... that was surprising, though. To 
think Ines would leap forward as the star 
of the show here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm famous for my quick dash out of 
the gate♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Buuut I guess it makes sense that you 
couldn't guess. We don't really talk about 
heavy stuff back in the room."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you wouldn't really want to bring 
that kind of stuff into your room.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have dreams of my own. It'd be 
boring to stay as just "Ryan-chan's Friend 
A" forever.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Besides~ I'd get a little jealous.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'cause Ryan-chan's always talking 
about McQueen-chan, and only McQueen-chan~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even as your best friend, I'm still your 
rival too, so I was hoping you'd look my 
way a little more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm keeping an eye on Ines properly, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You think so~? If that's really true, you 
wouldn't leave me alone when I break away 
in the Satsuki Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run away as fast as I can, so I want 
Ryan-chan to grab me tightly from behind♪ 
Just kidding~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh... I don't think you can do that 
during a race, though."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, just kidding. Though you'd 
better come at me with the real intent to 
catch me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading back to my room. 
I'll leave the door unlocked!

Ines Fujin walked away with a light spring 
in her step.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A race... against Ines, huh... On the 
Classic stage...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With Ines, who had always been right 
beside me, laughing together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the Twinkle Series is truly 
amazing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To compete against my own roommate for a 
single award... I... I just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No... I just feel this strange sensation. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So this is where we belong. It suddenly 
feels... so very real.

Because they're competing as best friends, 
the joy and sorrow waiting beyond that are 
beyond measure...

Mejiro Ryan stared out at the unlit track. 
The finish post beyond it was... 
invisible.
